name: danwo-example-with-go
description: Quillwork, a team plan sold through Stripe Checkout: a Vue app on a Go JSON API and Postgres, whose Stripe webhook starts the plan and sends a welcome email through Resend.

scripts.build: vite build web && go -C api build -o ../dist/quillwork .
scripts.matrix: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "upgrades to the Team plan"
scripts.matrix:plan: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "upgrades to the Team plan" --plan
